MUTUAL NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information secret.

The receiving party may share confidential information with its employees who need to know it.

# Term
This agreement lasts for two years after the effective date.

ONE-WAY CONFIDENTIALITY AGREEMENT

The recipient shall not disclose confidential information to any third party.

The recipient shall return all confidential information when asked.
